svg.title: Schema roles preserve nested identities
svg.desc: Role metadata in the file prelude defines sample, cell, and UMI fields. Per-read values flow through sample assignment and within-sample correction into distinct A/x and B/x groups. Schematic excerpts, two hierarchy levels.
svg.title: Schema roles preserve nested identities
